reconciliation.title: Ablation Reconciliation: Frozen Test vs. Validation B
reconciliation.frozen_test_reason: In early frozen test results (engine/experiments/results/frozen_test_results.json), P3 achieved 0% goal completion because w_stall=0.0 (no stall livelock penalty), causing the vehicle to halt indefinitely in narrow corridors rather than actively bypassing obstacles.
reconciliation.val_b_reason: In Validation B (runs/val_b_manifest.json), the F3 stall persistence penalty was enabled (w_stall=4.00, w_prog=2.20), allowing P3 to dynamically bypass obstacles and achieve 56% overall completion (100% on Cattle Crossing & Highway Merge) while cutting crash rates from 60% down to 20%.
